Island overview map concept

Top-down island overview map: one hand-drawn map, muted teal-and-brass palette, 1930s nautical-chart style with bathymetric contour rings, six numbered region markers (1 camp/dock, 2 tidal flats, 3 shipwreck bay, 4 black-sail pirate camp, 5 sunken temple, 6 lighthouse and abyss rift). Dashed golden paths from camp to each region, compass rose, tide line. Painterly grain, no text labels beyond numbers.
